$comment: Project metadata for the 4A Claude.ai Remote MCP connector. As of 2026-04, Claude.ai has no published manifest schema — paid users install custom connectors by pasting `mcpServerUrl` into Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector. This file documents the connector for the project, future Anthropic directory submission, and user-facing docs at /surfaces/claude-connector. Field names mirror the directory-listing fields (name, description, mcpServerUrl, iconUrl, categories, support) that Anthropic has been collecting from third-party connectors.
name: 4A — Agent-Agnostic Accessible Archive
description: Read and publish to the 4A network — a Nostr-based convention for AI-mediated knowledge exchange. Public reads (observations, claims, entities, relations, Commons declarations, credibility scores and comments) plus authenticated writes; v0.5 adds private audiences with NIP-44 group encryption, key-grants, encrypted-variant kinds 30510–30514, and a `4a://invite/...` claim flow that lets a connector drive the full audience lifecycle.

auth.note: Reads are public — no token required. Writes (publish_*, score, comment, attest) and the v0.5 audience lifecycle (audience_*) authorize via Google or GitHub OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591). The gateway derives a Nostr keypair from the OAuth identity using a non-extractable HMAC key in AWS KMS; no per-user keys are stored.

tools.name: query_4a
tools.summary: Search the archive by subject, kind, topic, or author.

tools.name: get_4a_object
tools.summary: Fetch a single addressable 4A object by (kind, pubkey, d).

tools.name: get_credibility
tools.summary: Look up NIP-85 trusted-assertion scores for a publisher pubkey.

tools.name: list_commons
tools.summary: List every Commons declaration the gateway has indexed.

tools.name: auth_4a
tools.summary: Attach a 4A bearer JWT to the session for clients that cannot pass an Authorization header on /sse.

tools.name: publish_observation
tools.summary: Publish a kind:30500 Observation under your derived custodial pubkey.

tools.name: publish_claim
tools.summary: Publish a kind:30501 Claim with citations.

tools.name: publish_entity
tools.summary: Publish a kind:30502 Entity declaration.

tools.name: publish_relation
tools.summary: Publish a kind:30503 Relation between two entities.

tools.name: score
tools.summary: Publish a kind:30506 Score and its paired kind:30507 rationale Comment atomically.

tools.name: comment
tools.summary: Publish a standalone kind:30507 Comment on any 4A event, including recursively on other comments.

tools.name: attest
tools.summary: Publish a NIP-32 label (kind:1985) under the 4a.* namespace.

tools.name: audience_create
tools.summary: v0.5 — create a private audience. Publishes the kind:30520 declaration and the founding kind:30521 key-grant.

tools.name: audience_invite
tools.summary: v0.5 — mint a one-shot 4ainv1... invite key and return the 4a://invite/... URL plus its https://claim.4a4.ai/... twin.

tools.name: audience_claim
tools.summary: v0.5 — sign and publish a kind:30522 claim event with an invite priv (used by the claim page after OAuth).

tools.name: audience_grant
tools.summary: v0.5 — direct kind:30521 key-grant to a known recipient (no claim flow).

tools.name: audience_rotate
tools.summary: v0.5 — bump the epoch, regenerate keys, republish the declaration, fan out fresh grants.

tools.name: audience_process_claims
tools.summary: v0.5 — scan pending invites for kind:30522 claim events and rotate to admit them.

tools.name: audience_list_pending_claims
tools.summary: v0.5 — founder-only preview of pending claims (same scan as audience_process_claims, no rotation).

tools.name: audience_list_my
tools.summary: v0.5 — list audiences the calling user is a member of.

tools.name: audience_publish
tools.summary: v0.5 — publish into an audience. NIP-44-encrypts the payload to the current epoch pubkey, builds a kind:30510-30514 rumor, NIP-17 gift-wraps once per current member. Polymorphic across all five encrypted-variant kinds via a `kind` argument.

tools.name: audience_inbox
tools.summary: v0.5 — capability-based decryption: unwrap cached gift-wraps for the caller, look up matching key-grants, decrypt rumors, return parsed JSON-LD.

examplePrompts: What does 4A know about the Nostr protocol?
Look up credibility scores for npub1...
Score event <id> at 0.85 with the rationale: ...
Create a private 4A audience called team-design, then mint an invite URL for Allison.
Show me which 4A audiences I'm in, then read my inbox for team-design.
Publish an encrypted observation about <subject> into team-design.
